# tomswallapi_rule (Resource)

A fleet-global firewall intent. Source and dest are shorewall-style element lists (bare zone, or zone:+ipset / zone:&fqdn); a selector must always be paired with a zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_rule" "ssh_loc_to_dmz" {
  action = "accept"
  source = ["loc"]
  dest   = ["dmz"]
  proto  = "tcp"
  ports  = ["22"]
}

resource "tomswallapi_rule" "loc_to_cloudflare" {
  action    = "accept"
  source    = ["loc"]
  dest      = ["net:+asn_cloudflare"]
  portgroup = "https"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) accept, drop, reject, etc.
- `dest` (List of String) Dest element list.
- `source` (List of String) Source element list, e.g. ["loc", "net:+asn_cloudflare"].

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `log` (String) Log level for matching packets (e.g. info).
- `portgroup` (String) Named portgroup supplying proto+ports.
- `ports` (List of String) Explicit ports (used when portgroup is not set).
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation priority; lower is evaluated first.
- `proto` (String) Protocol (used when portgroup is not set).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Server-assigned rule id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_rule.ssh_loc_to_dmz 42
```
